# ICMA 9-10-2026

```{r}
ggplot(data=penguins, mapping = aes(x=flipper_length_mm,
                                    y= bill_length_mm)) + 
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
PlantGrowth
ggplot(data=PlantGrowth,
       mapping=aes(y=weight,x=group)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  stat_summary(geom="pointrange",
               fun.dat="mean_se",
               color="purple")
```
Yes this is tidy data

```{r}
flights |>
  arrange(desc(month))
```
```{r}
flights |> 
  filter(arr_delay > 120 & dep_delay ==0) |> arrange(desc(arr_delay))
```
```{r}
i<-flights |> 
  filter(arr_delay >120 & dep_delay ==0) |> 
  arrange(dep_delay)

j<-flights |> 
  arrange(dep_delay) |> 
  filter(arr_delay > 120 & dep_delay <= 0)
all(i == j)
```
